clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988 and stopping talk with your father about it in May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990. The shifts pile up across the death and into the year after, with your mother's money worry and distance from your father opening months before his death, and your brother's functioning falling after it.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, within the months before and after: you had migraines keeping you in bed starting in March 1994, called your brother most nights in April 1994, stopped returning his calls in June 1995, and stopped calling home in February 1996. You left home for college in September 1993, so the shifts in your functioning and your moves toward and away from your brother and mother fall in the year around your mother's diagnosis, with no one else's shifts showing in these months.
